messages:
arjun: heads-up — eu-west1 saw ~120 tiny GPU pods Pending since 03:12 UTC. schedule error: taints preventing scheduling. :confused:
infra-bot: [alert] 03:12 eu-west1: spike in PodPending on label=workload=tiny-job (severity=warning)
jess: can you paste kubectl describe for one of the stuck pods?
arjun: sure, one excerpt:
```
Name: tiny-job-5k2q
Status: Pending
Events:
  Type    Reason            Age   From               Message
  ----    ------            ----  ----               -------
  Warning FailedScheduling  2m    default-scheduler  0/24 nodes are available: 24 node(s) had taints that the pod didn't tolerate.
```
kai: looks like gpu nodes got tainted—who applied that?
jess: checking node taints now
jess: node/eu-west1-gpu-12 taints: gpu-reserved=maintenance:NoSchedule, drain-time=2025-03-18T03:00Z
tomas: Ops ran a batch drain to reprovision drivers during the maintenance window — those taints were supposed to be NoSchedule but we didn't cordon some warm pool nodes earlier
arjun: warm pool decommissioned yesterday after cost cleanup; pods from tiny-job are strict no-tolerations so they queue
kai: binpacking note — when we drain warmpool, small pods end up fragmenting capacity on remaining hosts; scheduler can't fit 1GPU tiny pods because larger jobs occupy slack
jess: short-term: we can push a toleration to the tiny-job rollout to tolerate gpu-reserved for 2h while we uncordon warmpool nodes. agree?
arjun: +1, but prefer targeted patch: only tiny-job and eval-runner namespace
tomas: also remove driver reprovision taint flow from automated job until we fix warm pool lifecycle
kai: long-term: we should change scheduling to prefer pack small pods onto warm nodes first (binpack affinity), or add fractional co-location binpacking to reduce fragmentation
jess: cost question — if we re-enable warmpool we pay reserved hours vs pack better. ops: what's cost vs SLO hit?
arjun: quick calc: enabling 10 warmpool nodes ~ $1.8k/day but avoids 30% pending latency for batch evals -> fine for day
infra-bot: deploy job tiny-job-toleration-canary started by jess at 03:28 UTC
jess: rolled toleration to 10% canary
kai: monitor pack/fill rate and eviction churn; if evictions rise revert
arjun: will run scheduler logs grep for Fit/NoFit and post results in 10m
jess: thanks — ping here when warm pool is uncordoned
arjun: posted logs: 15x "NoFit: node(s) had taints", 42x "NoFit: Insufficient nvidia.com/gpu", 3 eviction events
jess: ok uncordoning 5 warm nodes now
tomas: removing taint from eu-west1-gpu-12/13/14/15/16
arjun: pods started scheduling, back to Nominal. :tada:
jess: follow-up ticket to prevent automated warm pool decommission during driver rollout: INFRA-2247
kai: follow-up idea: add preflight check that draining won't fragment tiny pod placements
jess: noted. closing thread once INFRA-2247 is created
arjun: INFRA-2247 created
sre-oncall: ack :eyes:
